desc: Ideation: answer for i = largest d | A_i with cnt[d] ≥ K; sieve-based O(M log M) approach
Write full solution: parse input via sys.stdin.buffer.read().split(), build freq array of size M+1
Build cnt[d] = sum of freq over multiples of d (harmonic sieve, ~14M ops)
Build best[x]: for d ascending with cnt[d] ≥ K, set best[m] = d for all multiples m of d
Output best[A_i] per line via '\n'.join; K=1 and K=N edge cases handled naturally by the sieve
Review code: array('i') keeps memory ~12MB total; ~28M tight inner loop steps acceptable; samples verified mentally (3,4,6,1,6 ✓)
